name: Single_Phase_Meter
description: Single-phase AC meter for power and directional energy measurements at an off-grid equipment or branch connection.

topology.description: May connect to inverters, PCS, diesel generators, and loads. No connection is required by this product.

P.name: Max Voltage
P.description: Configured maximum voltage for the metering point.

P.name: Max Current
P.description: Configured maximum primary current for the metering point, consistent with the installed current transformer ratio.

P.name: Rated Frequency
P.description: Rated frequency of the AC supply at the metering point.

P.name: Max Power
P.description: Configured active power limit for the metered equipment or branch.

M.name: AC Power
M.description: Single-phase AC active power. Positive for import and negative for export relative to the configured meter installation direction.

M.name: AC Reactive Power
M.description: Single-phase reactive power reported by the meter. Map the device reactive-power sign convention for the instance.

M.name: AC Power Factor
M.description: Overall power factor reported by the meter. Sign represents inductive or capacitive behavior according to the device convention; it does not indicate active power direction.

M.name: AC Frequency
M.description: AC frequency measured at the metering point.

M.name: AC Voltage
M.description: Voltage between line and neutral at the single-phase metering point.

M.name: AC Current
M.description: Current magnitude at the single-phase metering point.

M.name: AC Import Energy Total
M.description: Cumulative AC active energy in the import direction relative to the configured meter installation.

M.name: AC Export Energy Total
M.description: Cumulative AC active energy in the export direction relative to the configured meter installation.

M.name: AC Import Daily Energy
M.description: Imported AC energy for the current day, calculated by the EMS from the change in M114 relative to its period baseline. Period starts at local midnight. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: AC Import Weekly Energy
M.description: Imported AC energy for the current week, calculated by the EMS from the change in M114 relative to its period baseline. Period starts at the configured calendar-week boundary. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: AC Import Monthly Energy
M.description: Imported AC energy for the current month, calculated by the EMS from the change in M114 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on the first day of the calendar month. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: AC Import Quarterly Energy
M.description: Imported AC energy for the current quarter, calculated by the EMS from the change in M114 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on January 1, April 1, July 1, or October 1. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: AC Import Yearly Energy
M.description: Imported AC energy for the current calendar year, calculated by the EMS from the change in M114 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on January 1. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires annual aggregation support and a valid year-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.
